column1: # Perl corpus: objects. Format and regeneration: crates/builtins/src/perl/tests.rs.

column2: package Box; our $AUTOLOAD; sub AUTOLOAD {print $AUTOLOAD,'|',$_[1],"\n"} sub DESTROY {} package main; my $o=bless {},'Box'; $o->missing(8);
package Thing; my $o=bless {}; print ref($o),"\n";
my $o=bless [],'Thing'; print ref($o),"\n";
my $n=7; my $o=bless \$n,'Thing'; print ref($o),"|$$o\n";
package Box; sub get {$_[0]{x}} package main; my $o=bless {x=>4},'Box'; my $fn=$o->can('get'); print $fn->($o),'|',defined($o->can('absent'))?1:0,"\n";
package Box; sub name { $_[0] } package main; print Box->name(),"\n";
package Demo; sub show {$_[0]} package main; print Demo::->show(),"\n";
package Box; sub new {my ($c,$v)=@_; bless {v=>$v},$c} package main; my $b=Box->new(7); print ref($b),"|$b->{v}\n";
package Box; sub DESTROY {print $_[0]{x}} package main; {my $x=bless {x=>'end'},'Box'; print 'start|'} print "|after\n";
package Box; sub DESTROY {print "destroy|"} package main; my $a=bless {},'Box'; my $b=$a; undef $a; print 'still|'; undef $b; print "gone\n";
package Box; sub DESTROY {print $_[0]{x}} package main; {my $a=bless {x=>'a'},'Box'; {my $b=bless {x=>'b'},'Box'; print 'start|'} print '|inner|'} print "|outer\n";
my $o=bless {},'Box'; print $o->DOES('Box')?1:0,"\n";
package Base; package Box; our @ISA=('Base'); package main; my $o=bless {},'Box'; print join('|', map {$o->isa($_)?1:0} qw(Box Base Other UNIVERSAL)),"\n";
package Base; sub get { $_[0]{x} } package Box; our @ISA=('Base'); package main; my $o=bless {x=>11},'Box'; print $o->get(),"\n";
package Base; sub get {1} package Box; our @ISA=('Base'); sub get {2} package main; print Box->get(),"\n";
package Base; sub get {$_[0]{x}} package Box; our @ISA=('Base'); sub get {$_[0]->SUPER::get()+1} package main; my $o=bless {x=>11},'Box'; print $o->get(),"\n";
package Box; sub get { $_[0]{x} } package main; my $o=bless {x=>8},'Box'; my $m='get'; print $o->$m(),"\n";
package Box; sub get { $_[0]{x} } package main; my $o=bless {x=>7},'Box'; print $o->get(),"\n";
package Box; use overload '-'=>sub {$_[2] ? $_[1]-$_[0]{x} : $_[0]{x}-$_[1]}; package main; my $o=bless {x=>8},'Box'; print $o-3,'|',3-$o,"\n";
package Box; use overload bool=>sub {0}; package main; my $o=bless {},'Box'; print $o?'true':'false',"\n";
package Box; use overload '0+'=>sub {$_[0]{x}}, fallback=>1; package main; my $o=bless {x=>8},'Box'; print $o+3,"\n";
package Box; use overload '""'=>sub {$_[0]{x}}; package main; my $o=bless {x=>'custom'},'Box'; print "$o\n";
my $o=bless {},'Old'; my $p=bless $o,'New'; print ref($o),'|',ref($p),"\n";
